news.title: Ahmedabad civic body renews push for building safety
news.para: Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation has reiterated the need for structural safety inspections of buildings over 15 years old. Owners are required to have their structures inspected by qualified engineers and submit certificates. Previous attempts at enforcing compliance have not been effective, with little action taken by building management. Without strict enforcement, voluntary compliance remains low, hindering safety protocols.

news.title: Bhubaneswar development body to adjust application fee with flat cost
news.para: The Bhubaneswar Development Authority has updated its fee structure for the Ekamra Residency project. Applicants who are approved will have their Rs 10,000 fee deducted from the total flat price. Those who do not qualify will receive a complete refund of their earnest deposit and application fee. Additional benefits include GST exemptions and lower stamp duty rates. Applications are now open for this housing initiative at Subudhipur.

news.title: Finish pending rural housing projects in week: Bihar rural development minister
news.para: Rural Development Minister Shravan Kumar held a meeting to assess key schemes designed to boost housing and social welfare initiatives. He ordered officials to finalize all pending housing projects within the week, targeting eligible beneficiaries without delays. Kumar also stressed the importance of timely MGNREGA payments and initiated an inquiry into beneficiaries who were overlooked.

news.title: Onsite RMC plants now allowed within one kilometre of building plots in Ahmedabad
news.para: The town planning committee of the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation has ratified a revised policy on ready-mix concrete (RMC) plants, focusing on curbing air pollution through stricter placement regulations. RMC plants will only receive approval within one kilometer of smaller building sites under particular conditions. Builders must notify the AMC when applying for development permits for on-site RMC facilities.

news.title: SILA raises ₹300 crore from Norwest; plans ₹500 crore investment in Mumbai real estate
news.para: SILA has raised ₹300 crore from Norwest in its real estate development arm, SILA Properties, at a valuation of ₹1,000 crore. The company plans to deploy ₹500 crore over the next two years towards land and project acquisitions across residential and commercial developments in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

news.title: Lucknow development body moots construction ban within 500 metres of Outer Ring Road
news.para: Lucknow Development Authority intends to propose restrictions on new construction along the Outer Ring Road. This initiative aims to create a green belt around the corridor for better planning. The proposal will be reviewed by the LDA board on October 17. Additionally, the board will address other key topics including the Vashisth Nagar housing scheme. They will discuss potential increases in flood protection charges affecting development projects and approvals.

news.title: Chandigarh housing board to retain changes allowed by earlier policies
news.para: The Chandigarh Housing Board has rolled out a new framework for independent house owners, enabling them to retain lawful changes made under previous regulations by submitting appropriate documentation. While homeowners can maintain constructions that exceed earlier limits, future modifications must adhere to current building ordinances. They are also required to inform the board about any changes within three months to avoid penalties.

news.title: Eligibility alone will decide allocation of flats in Indiramma towers: Telangana housing minister
news.para: The Telangana government aims to provide equitable housing across all constituencies, irrespective of political representation. The Indiramma housing initiative focuses on delivering dignified homes to urban poor residents. With the commencement of the first phase, they plan to build one lakh residences, allowing selected beneficiaries to obtain their flats free of registration fees, while ensuring that future applicants will also qualify.

news.title: No RWA polls for a decade, extra units in Express Garden Apartment, Allahabad HC seeks replies
news.para: The Allahabad High Court has mandated the developer of Express Garden Apartment to file an affidavit regarding unauthorized construction. Allegations have emerged that the AOA has not conducted elections since 2015, affecting its governance. The court has scheduled the next hearing for November 5, requiring responses from the developer and AOA members. A summons will also be issued to both the developer and AOA representatives.

news.title: Consumer forum orders Mohali builder to pay ₹75,000, 9% interest over flat flaws
news.para: The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission has delivered a significant verdict for a Mohali homebuyer, mandating the developer to pay 9% interest on deposits attributed to delays in construction. Complaints highlighted failures in construction quality and absent clearance certificates. The ruling requires the builder to fix defects, restore parking, and includes compensation for the buyer's mental anguish and legal costs.

news.title: Haryana CM orders clear power billing norms for housing societies
news.para: Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini has ordered power distribution companies to set clear electricity billing norms for Gurgaon. The directive follows numerous complaints from residents about excessive charges above approved rates. Saini emphasized the need for timely resolution of billing disputes and effective complaint policies. Meanwhile, the Haryana Electricity Regulatory Commission has increased scrutiny and initiated audits of various group housing societies.

news.title: Strange that buyers who have paid in full can’t register flats because of govt-builder dispute: Allahabad HC
news.para: Homebuyers at Ajnara Homes in Greater Noida West are facing a registration standstill due to unpaid dues, prompting the Allahabad High Court to seek solutions from involved authorities. APV Realty Limited owes upwards of Rs 60 crore, which has created a backlog where approximately 75,000 flats remain unregistered in Noida and Greater Noida. The matter is scheduled for another court hearing on October 30.

news.title: Delhi civic body finds 21,000 buildings violating land-use norms, plans phased sealing
news.para: In a recent survey, the Municipal Corporation of Delhi has discovered 21,000 properties flouting land-use regulations, including coaching centres and grocery stores nestled in residential zones. Property owners will receive notices prior to the phased sealing process. This initiative is in response to a Supreme Court directive aimed at curbing unauthorized commercial enterprises in these areas, with compliance and conversion charges playing a key role in the sealing decisions.

news.title: Delhi LG directs DDA officials towards faster execution of TOD policy
news.para: Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu conducted a thorough review of the DDA's Transit-Oriented Development policy aimed at bolstering Delhi's infrastructure. The ambitious Master Plan for Delhi 2047 intends to dramatically increase housing availability to meet the demands of a growing population. Over the next ten years, around 17 lakh new dwelling units are slated for development under the TOD policy, with the DDA prioritizing timely completion and milestone compliance.

news.title: GMR Airports incorporates subsidiary to explore real estate opportunities
news.para: GMR Airports Ltd has launched GMR Aero Realty Ltd, a new subsidiary aimed at tapping into real estate ventures. Officially established on October 13 with an initial capital of Rs 1 crore, GMR Aero Realty is set to pursue various land development opportunities in the future. Currently, the subsidiary has yet to commence operations and confirms that this initiative does not involve related parties or external interests.

news.title: Gurugram: ED attaches ₹136-crore assets of  Ocean Seven Buildtech, promoters
news.para: Assets valued at over Rs 136 crore tied to Ocean Seven Buildtech Pvt Ltd have been confiscated by the Enforcement Directorate. The seizure includes land parcels in Rajasthan and bank funds associated with the company's promoters. Swaraj Singh Yadav is now in custody for allegedly defrauding individuals seeking affordable housing.

news.title: Residents, experts question Pune civic body's move making builders liable for water supply in merged areas
news.para: The Pune Municipal Corporation has mandated that developers are now accountable for ensuring water supply in newly merged regions. This decision has faced backlash from residents and urban planners, who view it as an abdication of municipal responsibility. Developers will be obligated to manage water supply for three years or until permanent connections are made.

news.title: Lucknow development body earmarks ₹100 crore for villages under IT City project
news.para: The Lucknow Development Authority is set to channel Rs 100.7 crore into vital infrastructure projects aimed at enhancing village connectivity under the IT City initiative. Officials have been directed to hasten development, particularly for roads and drainage systems. Currently, only a handful of roads are under construction despite numerous tenders issued.

news.title: India office gross absorption rises 6% to 60.7 million sq ft in Jan-Sep 2026: Report
news.para: Office gross absorption across India’s top six cities rose 6% year-on-year to 60.7 million sq ft during January-September 2026, while new supply increased 23% to 43.7 million sq ft. Savills expects full-year leasing to reach around 74 million sq ft.

news.title: Bhumika Realty targets ₹1,000 crore cumulative land investment in Faridabad by March 2027
news.para: Bhumika Realty has invested over ₹550 crore in land acquisitions in Faridabad over the past 12 months and expects cumulative land investment in the city to exceed ₹1,000 crore by March 2027. The company is expanding across residential, plotted and mixed-use developments.
